text:
Alex M: EDR alert on alex-macbook.local — high-confidence malware (process injection). EDR quarantined file and killed process. Detection ID EDR-202503-7841. Anyone oncall?
EDR-Bot: Detection EDR-202503-7841 — quarantine applied to /Users/alex/bin/rdworker (sha256: d4c3f2b9a7e4d8c1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5). Process PID 7234 terminated. Endpoint isolated (network).
Priya S: Oncall sec here. Thanks Alex. Can you confirm whether VPN was connected and if there were any large transfers?
Alex M: VPN disconnected earlier today. I had Zoom + Chrome open. Not aware of any big uploads. No USBs attached.
Priya S: Got it. Jared, can you pull a remote forensic collection (memory + disk) and run our YARA rules against it?
Jared K: Initiating remote collection now. ETA ~20m. Command: `edrctl collect --id EDR-202503-7841 --artifacts memory,fs,network`
Jared K: Started YARA scan against the sample set; initial pass only matches the signature that triggered quarantine.
Camille R: Adding to tracker as INC-2025-034. Preliminary severity: medium until IOC confirmed.
Priya S: Also enable increased audit logging for Alex's account and freeze automated RBAC changes for 24h for related service principals.
Nina (IT): I've revoked the laptop's VPN cert and set MDM to 'quarantine' — device flagged for re-provisioning after forensic image.
Alex M: Quick question — I used a local dev kube cluster yesterday. Any need to rotate KMS keys? I didn't use prod creds on this box.
Priya S: Not immediately. We'll check KMS access logs for anomalous tokens; rotate if we see suspicious activity.
Jared K: Forensic pull complete. Uploaded to secure bucket: s3://redwood-sec/forensics/EDR-202503-7841. Memory dump shows injected module `libsys64.so` loaded by rdworker. Sample SHA256 same as quarantine hash.
EDR-Bot: Sandbox detonation report uploaded to the sandbox UI. Summary: persistence via LaunchAgents, spawns reverse TCP to 13.82.94.12, attempts to exfiltrate files under ~/Documents using base64 encode. Behavioral family match: backdoor.xgen (low confidence).
Priya S: Based on sandbox, escalate to high severity. Camille, please open a blocker to scan any customer-facing credential stores accessed since last 48h.
Camille R: Blocker opened and assigned to SecOps and Infra. Scheduling credential and access log scans across prod endpoints.
Priya S: Action items (short):
- Jared: finish image & schedule reprovision/wipe (priority).
- Alex: share `brew list --versions` and `last` output + any recent installs.
- SecEng: write detection rule for `rdworker` and `libsys64.so` persistence indicators.
- SecOps: check KMS & audit logs, confirm no unauthorized key access.
Alex M: Will paste `brew list --versions` and `last -n 50` outputs here in 10m.
Jared K: Device wipe planned after final forensic confirmation. ETA ~6h.
Priya S: We'll follow up with a brief postmortem and update our detection coverage. Thanks all :thumbsup:
